name: White dragon's hoard
slug: The white dragon's looted hoard of coin, gems, art, goods, and a few magic items, dated November 3 of the previous year.
description: The white dragon's looted hoard, dated in the DM's notes to November 3 of the previous year. It held coin, about two dozen gemstones of various values, art objects of various values, mundane goods, and four or five magic items. Pieces called out are Dana's magic broom, a set of bone dice, a shrine with a statuette, a brazier, and an altar to a god of dragon minions, a scroll with a poem, the skull of a fiend or celestial, seven candlesticks with a holy symbol, a gold birdcage, a box of turquoise animal figurines, Ciri's starburst ring or bracelet, and the lantern now fused to the staff.
